purpose: Capability-level handoff from the dependency-free acquisition emulator to a first coherent four-channel loopback and device record.

minimumCapabilities.host: A computer able to run a maintained Node.js runtime
minimumCapabilities.interface: One full-duplex interface with at least four phase-coherent inputs and four phase-coherent outputs sharing one sample clock
minimumCapabilities.analogueProtection: Input/output levels, grounding and isolation appropriate to the selected interface and emulator
minimumCapabilities.cables: Eight short, labelled connections plus one independent loopback/calibration path

loopbackAdmission.rule: Pass the coherent loopback and frozen negative controls before attaching a physical four-mode emulator. Do not refit by direction.

stopConditions: Any input or output clips or reaches a protection limit.
Channel order, polarity or shared-clock status is unresolved.
A single calibration fails to predict both basis injections.
Forward and reverse data require direction-specific nuisance parameters.
A fixed-path control returns a statistically resolved rotation.
Supply, timing or detector records are missing from a claimed physical run.
externalBoundary: The packet specifies and rehearses the acquisition contract. It contains no measured voltage, current, impedance, supply-power, temperature or timing record from physical equipment and therefore makes no claim that a physical device exhibits the simulated holonomy.
